title: Claude Code local settings with secrets found in 1,122 GitHub files
summary: A security blog post reports finding 1,122 public GitHub files containing Claude Code \`.claude/settings.local.json\` entries where commands approved through “Don&\#x27;t Ask Again” embedded passwords or keys. The exposure is conditional: a developer had to manually create and commit the local settings file and put a secret directly in an approved command; a Claude Code team member identified as Boris said the file is meant to stay local and is auto-gitignored when Claude creates it. Boris said Claude Code has not historically scrubbed secrets but the team is looking into preventing this.
